## What's Changed

### New Features

- Added naming support for 29 AzureRM resource types, bringing the provider inventory from 494 to 520 definitions after invalid and obsolete definitions were removed.
- Added deterministic plan-time calculation for `azurecaf_name` resources when random generation uses a non-zero `random_seed`.
- Added mock-AzureRM schema validation without Azure credentials, including PR-scoped and weekly full-sweep workflows.

### Changes

- Migrated provider operations to Terraform SDK Context CRUD APIs and `diag.Diagnostics`.
- Made seeded random generation deterministic across plan and apply, and moved unseeded generation to `crypto/rand`.
- Restored fresh random generation when a name data source omits `random_seed`; explicit seeds, including `0`, remain deterministic.
- Made `go generate` emit gofmt-clean output so generated-code freshness checks are idempotent.
- Regenerated the provider model and synchronized the resource documentation with all 520 definitions.

### Bug Fixes

- Preserved environment-variable behavior so missing variables always fail, while `fails_if_empty` additionally rejects explicitly empty values.
- Propagated state, regex, plan-time, and imported-state errors instead of discarding them.
- Corrected the `validation_regex` JSON tag.
- Rejected an invalid trailing pipe character in API Management and Load Test names.
- Corrected 29 new or updated naming definitions to accept their documented one-character minimum.
- Preserved unseeded random names during refresh so a plan after apply remains clean.
- Deferred plan-time name generation when any naming input, including list elements, is unknown, avoiding placeholder-derived names and inconsistent apply results.
- Corrected the mock-AzureRM harness so resource overrides are merged, generated HCL satisfies constrained schemas, initialization is isolated from user CLI settings, and tests verify the local provider binary.
- Prevented mock-harness unit tests from dirtying tagged release worktrees with Python bytecode caches.
- Updated the GoReleaser archive configuration to supported v2 syntax and normalized release-hook dependency metadata.

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the deprecated `azurecaf_naming_convention` resource.
- Realigned 64 existing resource slugs with current CAF abbreviations; generated names can change when `use_slug = true`.
- Removed `azurerm_app_service_plan`, `azurerm_lb_backend_pool`, and `azurerm_role_assignment` naming definitions.
- Corrected naming constraints for Custom Provider, Load Balancer child resources, Private Link Service, Storage Table, Synapse Workspace, and Web Application Firewall Policy.
- Corrected seeded random generation to use the complete alphabet; identical `random_seed` values can produce different suffixes than v1.x.

Read the [v2.0.0 migration guide](https://github.com/aztfmod/terraform-provider-azurecaf/blob/v2.0.0/docs/migration-v2.md) before upgrading. Review the complete Terraform plan because changed names can force replacement of downstream Azure resources.
